2. Explains why unique_realm/1 alone is insufficient (JitProvisioningConfig.default/1 enabled: true fallback)
3. Specifies Application.put_env pattern for :oidc_jit_provisioning with on_exit cleanup
4. States the config mutation must precede insert_tenant_for_realm!
5. Explicitly scopes out: config/test.exs, lib/, scripts/test_parallel.sh

7. Notes test_parallel.sh exit-code concern is retracted
8. No compilable Elixir code in the design artefact (only @spec + prose)

Also verify: the design is unambiguous enough for ELIXIR-DEV to implement from. The fix pattern must be complete: what lines change, what the config mutation looks like (shape of the map entry), where on_exit goes, ordering relative to insert_tenant_for_realm!.

result.summary: PASS -- all 8 acceptance criteria independently verified against the design artefact. (1) Names exactly one file: test/letflow/plugs/auth_pipeline_configurable_verifier_test.exs. (2) Explains why unique_realm/1 alone is insufficient: for_realm/1 falls back to default/1 which returns enabled: true for unknown realms. (3) Specifies Application.put_env pattern with on_exit cleanup, config entry shape %{enabled: false, default_status: :active, default_roles: []} explicit. (4) Config mutation precedes insert_tenant_for_realm! -- ordering stated explicitly in §3.3 and §3.4 diagram. (5) config/test.exs, lib/, scripts/test_parallel.sh all explicitly scoped out. (6) auth_pipeline_test.exs:131 (bpm-default) noted as ISS-0108, out of scope. (7) test_parallel.sh exit-code concern confirmed retracted, no change needed. (8) No compilable Elixir code -- only @spec signatures and prose throughout. Design is unambiguous enough for ELIXIR-DEV to implement.
